Not for finding your own new creators — use influencer-discovery. 竞品达人合作追踪/竞品营销分析
trigger_phrases: see who my rivals partner with
routing_contract.when_to_use: Use when the user wants to understand a competitor's influencer marketing: which creators they partner with, what campaigns and content formats they run, estimated reach and spend, and where they leave gaps. Activate for competitive benchmarking, finding untapped or former-competitor creators, and spotting strategy shifts over time.
